GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 201 (31 Dec 45) ESS-FI
(SCAPIN - 526)
APO 500
31 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Unfreezing of Accounts of Ando Moku
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 201 (15 Oct 45) ESS, subject: “Freezing of Accounts of Ando Moku and Imori Meiji.”
2. You are directed to release all accounts of Ando Moku, Chief of Personnel Section, Imperial Bank of Tokyo which were frozen in compliance with the above Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
